notes.zh: 「检查更新」直连失败后走本地 HTTP 代理（默认 7897）。设置里可改代理端口。这不会启用 agent 的 web 工具。
notes.en: Check for updates retries through the local HTTP proxy (default 7897) after a direct failure. Settings can change the port. This does not enable agent web tools.

notes.zh: 第一个可在设置中检查更新的桌面版本。安装包按 releases/<version>/ 保存，不再覆盖上一版。用户数据仍在 ~/.dsh。
notes.en: First desktop build that can check for updates from Settings. Installers live under releases/<version>/ instead of overwriting the previous file. User data stays in ~/.dsh.
